findings.message: Kernel handoff is requested but not accepted.
findings.remediation: Pause execution until the new owner accepts the handoff and autosave snapshot.

findings.message: Kernel memory usage exceeds the lease limit.
findings.remediation: Queue execution or increase the approved resource lease before reruns.
Renew, transfer, or shut down the kernel before running more notebook cells.

findings.message: Cell output was produced before the current kernel restart.
findings.remediation: Rerun the cell after the latest restart before freezing the manuscript.

findings.message: Cell source changed after the last recorded output.
findings.remediation: Queue the cell for rerun and refresh linked manuscript outputs.

findings.message: Publication-ready notebook cell still has unresolved comments.
findings.remediation: Resolve inline reviewer comments or move the cell out of publication-ready state.

findings.message: Cell execution is blocked because its kernel lease is missing or expired.
findings.remediation: Renew the lease or queue the cell for a valid owner.
